test.//: Default (in-process) lane. The live JVM/Python conformance matrix moved to gate.e2e.ts under the on-demand `e2e` target (which owns `apigen-java:package` + `apigen-python-env:build`), so this lane no longer needs a JVM. Override of the inferred `test` target carries only `dependsOn` (`lint`/`^build`) plus `inputs` excluding `*.e2e.ts`; executor/cache/outputs come from inference.
test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. REACHABILITY (2026-09-28, backlog-e2e-cache-separation): it is NOT in any `test.dependsOn` (the default lane stays fast), but it IS reached by the push/CI gate's `nx affected -t e2e` — the gate's target list is canonicalised in `tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs` (`GATE_TARGETS = ['test','e2e']`), which `.githooks/pre-push` and both CI workflows consume — and by `publish` via the conditional in `tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js` (`hasE2e ? ["e2e"] : []`). It is cached (`cache:true` + `inputs`) so a repeat gate run is a cache HIT, never an uncached re-run. It runs the sibling *.e2e.ts suite via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is the resource prerequisites those tests need: `conformance` (the SINGLE live-matrix execution path — its durable report is what gate.e2e.ts asserts against, so the live TS+Python+Java matrix is never duplicated), plus `apigen-java:package` and `apigen-python-env:build` (the JVM/Python host prerequisites the lane's own runJavaMatrix negative-control and the matrix need).
